_README: SPK-4 HELD-OUT set. Synthetic, as with disclosures.json.
Why this file exists: the main corpus scored 76/76, and that number is close to
worthless, because the same person wrote both the rules and the cases. Fitting a regex
list to a corpus you authored measures nothing.
Every case below deliberately uses DIFFERENT SURFACE FORM from the patterns in
spk4_safeguard.py: different verbs, Telugu kinship terms, code-switching, indirect
phrasing, misspellings, and Indian English idiom absent from the suppressor list.
Expect this to score badly. That is the point -- it estimates how the rules floor
behaves on language nobody anticipated, which is the only condition that matters in
